thread:
maya: Quick heads-up — we're shipping a small change to audit export retention defaults next Tue. Need a short customer-facing note + docs PR + SDK example for the new `retention_period_days` param.
liam: Got it. I'll draft the customer note. Where should we call out migration steps? short bullets?
olivia: Legal: prefer 'retention period' language vs 'TTL' for external-facing. Also include link to Data Processing Addendum and avoid implying access to customer exports. Use neutral phrasing: 'default retention period for audit exports is 90 days; customers may configure.'
liam: Draft phrasing: "Default retention period for exported audit logs is 90 days. Customers can configure export retention using the `retention_period_days` parameter on the export resource." Thoughts?
maya: +1. Also need SDK snippet in py and curl showing `retention_period_days` in create export API. Samir can you confirm API name and validation?
samir: API is exports.create with body {"retention_period_days": int, "scope": "tenant|organization"}. Validation: min 7, max 3650. Example below.
samir: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/exports \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"monthly-audit","retention_period_days":180,"scope":"tenant"}'
```
liam: Perfect. I'll include that curl and a Python snippet using the python SDK (client.exports.create). PR incoming: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/512
docs-bot: PR 512 opened by liam — reviewers: olivia, maya, samir. Preview build URL: https://deploy-preview-512--docs.redwood.com :eyes:
olivia: Quick legal checks: avoid 'permanent' anywhere; add SOC2-friendly note: 'Exports retained per customer configuration; Redwood does not access customer exports for analytics or product telemetry.'
maya: Good catch. liam, can you also add migration note for existing exports: 'Exports created before 2026-04-01 will retain their current setting unless reconfigured.'
liam: Adding a migration bullet and a short admin runbook for support. Will also add a `Deprecation` callout for old param `ttl_days` mapping.
support: FYI — we'll coordinate opt-in migrations. Please add contact tag and template for customer outreach.
samir: One more: internal SDK change — python client param is `retention_period_days`; older clients using `ttl_days` will be accepted but will emit a server-side warning header `X-Deprecation: ttl_days` for 90 days. Add that note to migration guide.
liam: Added deprecation note and example response header in the migration section.
olivia: LGTM from legal after the wording tweak to the SOC2 sentence. :white_check_mark:
maya: Timeline check — docs PR today, legal final sign-off by EOD, staging deploy tomorrow morning, customer email Wed afternoon. @support please prepare the outreach template.
liam: Will merge to staging once olivia approves and ping when live.
maya: Thanks team! :rocket:
